the 24 derivatives of the nitrofuryl and furapyrimidine ring systems were evaluated for their in vitro antifilariasis activity.

24 derivatives of the nitrofuran compounds, nitrofurazzone, nitrofurantoine, furazolidine, and furapyrimidine were tested in vitro for their antifilarial effects against microfilariae (Mf) and adult worms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of 3- and 4-substituents on the antifilarial action of nitrofuran compounds.
the effects of 3- and/ 4-substitution on the antimicrofiliarial action of nitrofurans.

the structure and antifilarial action of the nitrofuryl and furapyrimido compounds, and the results obtained indicate that the introduction of a methyl or methoxy group at the 3- and 4-position of the nitrofuran ring, or a methyl group at the 4-position of furapyrimido ring, will reduce the antifilarial activities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of electron-donating groups into 3- and/ or 4-position of the nitrofuryl nucleus decreased the antifilarial effect.
the introduction of -OCH3, -OC2Hs, -CH3 or -Cl into 3- and/4-position of nitrofurans, especially into the 3-position of nitro group, would decrease the antimicrofiliaria action.
the 3- and 4-substituent of nitrofuran compounds has a great effect on the antifilarial action of nitrofurans.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the antimicrofiliarial action of nitrofurans was not only due to the presence of nitro group in the 5-position of nitrofuraly ring, but also depended on the nature of substituent in the 3- and 4-position of the nitrofuranyl ring, which was related to the chemical structure of the compounds.
the introduction of alkyl group into nitrofuryl group decreased the activity against microfilariae in general.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure-activity relationship is very complicated and the effects are not always predictable.
3- and 4-substitutions on the nitrofurazan ring of nitrofuran compounds can affect their antimicrobial activities, but the effect is not the same on the microfilaria and macrofilaria of W bancrofti.
the antimicrofiliarial activity of nitrofurylamino compounds is closely related to the chemical structure and that the 4-substituent is more important than the 3-substituent.
